Noah Rivera: Heads-up — MarinerAI calls dropped ~58% W/W, embeddings nearly zero. Saw this pattern when teams start vendor shortlists.
Lina Gomez: Any personnel changes or notes?
Noah Rivera: Their ML lead moved to another role last week. New procurement PM Sam is driving cost review.
Tariq Ali: Can we get a tiny route breakdown? If embeds are gone but generate stays, that's feature deprecation not infra.
Noah Rivera: Quick numbers from metrics: total 7d=460 (prev=1100), embeds=4 (prev=420), /embed -98%, /generate -22%. Latency stable.
Lina Gomez: Okay. Action suggestions: 1) short cost-savings one-pager targeted at embed-heavy workloads, 2) offer a 60-day Dedicated trial or price cap, 3) SE session to map migration effort.
Tariq Ali: I'll prepare a unit-cost comparison (current vs typical marketplace discount) and simulate cache hit scenarios. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Noah Rivera: I'll book a 20-min intro with Sam for tomorrow. Keep it lightweight: cost + migration ask.
ops-bot: follow-up reminder scheduled 2026-04-02 09:00 for MarinerAI renewal-watch :calendar:
Sam (MarinerAI): Thanks — cost is top of our list. Happy to join the call.
Lina Gomez: Also include an ops-burden note (expected SE hours + handoff checklist). Procurement asks for that specifically.
Tariq Ali: Noted. I'll add an estimated SE checklist and a sample migration timeline (2-4 days for basic embed swap).
Noah Rivera: Plan: Tariq posts cost numbers EOD, Lina drafts one-pager by AM, Noah runs call and captures procurement asks. Marking renewal-watch.
Lina Gomez: Looping SalesOps if we need temporary concessions.
Noah Rivera: Thanks team — update thread after the call. :eyes:
